content.text:
Use a single full-width “Declared value” section, with one integrated chart panel per currency. The current split separates each currency total from its category bars and repeats explanatory text.

- Place the currency label, large total, and funding-entry count above its category chart. Keep the label “Known declared value” attached to each total.
- Show horizontal category bars with full category names at left and exact amounts at right. Use one restrained accent colour. Preserve signed bars and their zero baseline.
- Put “N stored declarations” and the registration date range in one compact metadata row above all currency panels. Keep “registered” in the label so readers do not infer payment dates.
- Place one shared caveat directly below the charts. “Includes earnings, gifts and support. Currencies shown separately.” Add conditional unknown-currency and undated-declaration counts there.
- Keep unavailable-amount counts beside the relevant total or category. A missing amount should display “Unavailable” with no bar, visibly distinct from zero.
- Keep recent support below a divider. Use “Recent donations and support” plus one short sentence preserving both loans and support received by party organisations. Retain source links and the declaration-history link.

The component can remain `MemberSummary.svelte`. Its structure should be a section header, coverage row, repeated currency figures, shared caveat, and the existing recent-support section. Continue accepting `MemberDetails` directly and reuse `categoryBars`; no new chart dependency or generic chart component is warranted.

Use a currency figure grid of `minmax(180px, .65fr) minmax(0, 1.8fr)` on desktop. Put the total on the left and chart on the right. Give each figure a subtle top border, 24px vertical padding, and a 32px column gap. Within each chart row, use a label/value grid above a 10px bar, with 16px between rows. Values use tabular numerals. Below 700px, place the total above the chart and reduce padding to 20px. Avoid cards, shadows, decorative icons, and animation.

Keep textual category names and amounts as the accessible content; mark the visual bars `aria-hidden`. Use semantic lists or figures, visible focus states for links, and enough contrast for muted caveats. Each currency panel must remain independent because the current data does not provide currency conversion.
